def longest_palindrome(s):
    def expand(lo, hi):
        while lo >= 0 and hi < len(s) and s[lo] == s[hi]:
            lo -= 1; hi += 1
        return s[lo+1:hi]
    out = ''
    for i in range(len(s)):
        p1 = expand(i, i)
        p2 = expand(i, i+1)
        if len(p1) > len(out): out = p1
        if len(p2) > len(out): out = p2
    return out
```
